PCRX.headline: Why Pacira BioSciences Skyrocketed Today
PCRX.description: Pacira BioSciences surged 44% after announcing its acquisition by Viatris for $36.50 per share, valuing the company at approximately $1.65 billion. The deal represents a 45% premium to the previous closing price and is expected to close by end of 2026. Viatris plans to leverage Pacira's non-opioid pain management products, including Exparel and Zilretta, to strengthen its innovative medicines business.
